name: Production SRE Incident Debugging
description: Multi-agent triage of 504 Gateway Timeouts in payment processing pipeline.
initial_context:
# Incident INC-8821: High Payment Gateway Latency

Triggered at 14:22 UTC. P99 latency exceeded 4500ms on /v1/charges.

steps.content:
## Metrics and Telemetry Analysis

Database connection pool saturation reached 100% on payments-primary cluster. Read replica lag spiked to 850ms at 14:28 UTC. Identified connection leak in transaction rollback handler.
steps.query: connection pool saturation payments-primary replica lag

steps.content:
## Distributed Traces and Error Logs

Found unhandled ConnectionResetError in StripeWebhookProcessor worker threads. Socket timeouts set to 60s caused 120 worker threads to hang indefinitely without returning connections to pool.

## Incident Mitigation and Resolution

Executed hotfix deployment 2.4.1: reduced socket timeout to 5s and wrapped rollback in 	ry...finally connection release block. Pool utilization normalized to 18% within 2 minutes.
steps.query: hotfix deployment v2.4.1 pool utilization normalized
